title: C link: fragment emission in lichen_link_tx for oversized SCHC payloads (needs C peer/session-security policy per spec 5.6 — depends on l1qw.3.7.6.1 human-only peer_table and rust AuthenticatedSchcPolicy parity)
description: Follow-up slice of b7z9.53.1 after the public API child lands. Rust reference: rust/lichen-schc/src/link.rs (FragmentationPolicy, AuthenticatedFragmentationPermit, create_fragment_sender, requires_fragmentation: len > MAX_SINGLE_FRAME_SCHC_PACKET) consumed by rust-node stack.rs. C currently returns -EMSGSIZE for compressed payloads exceeding single-frame size (lichen_link_tx.c ~134-165). DO NOT emit unauthenticated fragments: mirror the Rust authenticated-fragmentation policy (permit + per-peer state) or the C path becomes a downgrade vs Rust. Blocked on the human-only peer_table bead l1qw.3.7.6.1 for per-peer key/generation state. Coordinate design with Mark before wiring (downgrade risk).
